title: feat(nm2splt2z): 1-in 2-out at t vs t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fail then HOLD, face fail then HOLD, composition fail
science: The one member that isolates the only informative tick: 1-in-2-out split at tau=t vs t+1 on opposite z-probes. O is empty at every probe at t (split fail everywhere), fills at t+1 (split HOLD everywhere), so composition FAILS. Every later tau-pair in the band composes HOLD; this is the sole cut in the whole band where any bit changes.
